hero.body: Real, responsive website experiences built to become your own. Explore the design first; add it to AgentSam only when it feels right.

howItWorks.eyebrow: Designed to get out of your way
howItWorks.title: Choose. Add. Make it yours.
howItWorks.body: Theme Store distributes theme-packages. AgentSam owns your sites, settings and private drafts. A theme can change completely without its original product package being overwritten.

steps.title: Explore
steps.body: Browse the themes and explore a complete responsive site.

steps.title: Add to drafts
steps.body: Install a private, editable copy into your authorized AgentSam site.

steps.title: Customize
steps.body: Edit sections, tokens, forms and content in the real CMS v2 editor.
